scripts.docker:build: docker image inspect postgres:16-alpine >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'Error: postgres:16-alpine image not found. Run: docker pull postgres:16-alpine'; exit 1; } && npm run build && docker build -t tybooks:latest . && docker save tybooks:latest -o tybooks.tar && docker save postgres:16-alpine -o postgres.tar
scripts.docker:run: docker stop tybooks-app 2>/dev/null; docker rm tybooks-app 2>/dev/null; docker run -d --name tybooks-app -p 8080:8080 tybooks:latest; true
scripts.podman:run: podman stop tybooks-app 2>/dev/null; podman rm tybooks-app 2>/dev/null; podman run -d --name tybooks-app -p 8080:8080 docker.io/library/tybooks:latest; true
